newsitem.title: UK: BAA says Oct airport traffic up 4.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: BAA says Oct airport traffic up 4.9 pct.

text.p: British airports operator BAA Plc said traffic at its seven UK airports rose 4.9 percent in October compared with a year ago to 8.7 million passengers.

BAA said in a statement that traffic in the UK domestic and Irish markets both increased by 10 percent. The European scheduled market by five percent, North Atlantic traffic by six percent and other long haul traffic by seven percent.
The European charter market showed a decrease of 5.6 percent.
Among individual airports, Gatwick showed an overall increase of 10 percent and both Stanstead and Edinburgh recorded an overall increase of around 20 percent.
